capabilities: Edit note data through Obsidian properties
Organize notes into types and collections
Display items in grid, board, gallery or list layouts
Create new items from the GUI
extras: Full documentation is hosted elsewhere (linked from the README); a roadmap lists planned features such as aggregations, joins and Templater integration.
motivation: The author was inspired by Notion and AnyType and wanted to structure data using Obsidian notes and the newly released properties feature.
problem: Obsidian has no Notion-like way to structure, filter and visually browse notes as database items based on their properties.

relations.evidence: This plugins is inspired by Notion and AnyType
This plugins is inspired by Notion and AnyType
Thanks to Obsidian Typings for the extended typings

summary: Database-style plugin that creates, edits and queries sets of notes by their properties, with grid, board, gallery and list views.
